title: MarketComparisonResponse
description: Selling-options contract of the recommendation module (spec §16, §17, §21, §30, §32; ADR-0023, ADR-0024, ADR-0025, ADR-0026). Spec §41: produced by Backend; consumed by Frontend and QA. The root schema is the response of POST /api/v1/selling-options/compare and POST /api/v1/selling-options/simulate; `$defs` holds the request schemas and the parts of the response. The result is fully deterministic: no ML output enters the comparison, the score or the ranking (spec P9, §16; ADR-0030; docs/architecture/ML_ARCHITECTURE.md §4.10). Observed government prices (each option's `price`), user-supplied hypothetical inputs (`scenario.userOverrides`), configured assumptions (`transportAssumptions`) and derived ESTIMATED values (`estimates`) are kept in separate, labelled places. Hand-authored and authoritative for the API contract area.

CompareRequest.description: Input of a market comparison (spec §16 INPUT, §21 step 4; ADR-0023). Optional properties may be omitted or sent as null; both mean 'not set'. Unknown properties are rejected (VALIDATION_FAILED, UNKNOWN_FIELD).

commodityId.description: Commodity to compare. Its verified price unit must be 'Rs./Quintal', otherwise 422 UNSUPPORTED_PRICE_UNIT (ADR-0008). Unknown: 422 REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND.

varietyId.description: Optional variety of the commodity. When set, only observations of exactly this variety qualify; no other variety is substituted (ADR-0010 item 3). Must belong to commodityId, otherwise 422 REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND.

gradeId.description: Optional grade of the commodity, matched exactly like varietyId (ADR-0010 item 3).

quantity.description: Quantity to sell, in quantityUnit. Greater than 0 (ADR-0023); at most 9 integer and 3 fraction digits (selling_searches.quantity numeric(12,3)). No further limit applies; a quantity whose estimates exceed the stored precision answers 422 ESTIMATE_OUT_OF_RANGE (ADR-0040).

originLat.description: Latitude of the origin: the centroid of the district the farmer selected, exactly as listDistricts publishes it. Never an exact address (spec §21 step 3, §28; ADR-0023). The server accepts only a stored district centroid (6 decimal places); any other value answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with INVALID_VALUE on originLat and originLon (ADR-0039).

originLon.description: Longitude of the origin district centroid, exactly as listDistricts publishes it (ADR-0023; validated with originLat, ADR-0039).

maxDistanceKm.description: Search radius in whole kilometres. Default 150 when omitted or null (spec §16, F1.6). Greater than 0, with no further limit (ADR-0023).

SimulateRequest.description: Server-side What-If (spec §17; ADR-0026 item 3). The client uses it only when the maximum distance is raised above the original comparison radius; all other What-If changes are recalculated in the browser (spec §10). The server re-runs the comparison with the original run's weights and transport-assumption versions and these overrides, ranks by estimated net realization, and persists nothing (spec §32 'session-only'). Optional properties may be omitted or sent as null; both mean 'keep the original value'.

recommendationId.description: The comparison run being explored, from MarketComparisonResponse.recommendationId. Unknown: 422 REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND.

quantity.description: Hypothetical quantity in KILOGRAMS (spec §17 quantity slider), 100 to 5,000 (ADR-0026 item 4).

transportRatePerKm.description: Hypothetical transport rate in rupees per km per trip, 3 to 20 (spec §17; ADR-0026 item 4). Replaces the configured ratePerKm for this simulation only; system defaults never change (spec §32).

maxDistanceKm.description: Hypothetical search radius in whole kilometres, 25 to 300 (spec §17; ADR-0026 item 4).

ReasonCode.description: Fixed-vocabulary explanation of a ranked option (spec §16, P2, F1.12; trigger rules ADR-0024 item 6), in the spec §16 order: PRICE_ADVANTAGE (modal price in the top 25 % of options), LOWER_TRANSPORT (transport cost in the bottom 25 %), POSITIVE_TREND (RISING), STABLE_TREND (STABLE), RECENT_DATA (FRESH), SUITABLE_DISTANCE (distanceKm < 50), NEGATIVE_TREND (FALLING), STALE_DATA (STALE). Clients localize them (spec §46, §47 Q18). The vocabulary is closed: a new code needs a specification change.

ExclusionReason.description: Why a market inside the radius is not ranked. NO_RECENT_PRICE_DATA: no stored observation dated within the active stale window matched the commodity (and the selected variety and grade) at that market (spec §16; ADR-0010, ADR-0023).

RankingMethod.description: How `options` are ranked. DETERMINISTIC_COMPOSITE_SCORE: the spec §16 composite score with the active weights, ties by higher estimated net realization, then shorter distance, then market name (ADR-0024). NET_REALIZATION: estimated net realization, ties by shorter distance, then market name; used by What-If simulations (spec §17; ADR-0026 item 2). Market names compare in code-point order, and market id breaks a remaining tie. Values may be added in a minor contract version; ML-based ranking would first need an approved specification change or decision (docs/architecture/ML_ARCHITECTURE.md §4.10).

DecisionBasis.description: Declares how the result was produced, so clients never have to infer it.

weightsVersionId.description: Identifier of the recommendation-weights version (weights and freshness thresholds) used: the active version for a COMPARISON, the original run's version for a SIMULATION (spec §20 recommendation_runs.weights_id; ADR-0026 item 3).

mlContributed.description: Whether any ML output contributed to this result. Always false in contract version 1: ML is optional and never an input to comparison, scoring or ranking (spec P9, §16; ADR-0030). Forecasts, when the optional ML track exists, are served separately by GET /api/v1/markets/{marketId}/forecast and are never mixed into this response.

UserOverrides.description: Hypothetical inputs the user supplied for a simulation (spec §17, §32). They change only the derived estimates and ranking of this response, never the observed prices or the configured assumptions. Only the overrides actually supplied are present.

transportRatePerKm.description: Hypothetical rate in rupees per km per trip.

Scenario.description: Distinguishes a recorded comparison from a hypothetical simulation.

kind.description: COMPARISON: computed from the request and the active configuration, and recorded for evaluation (spec §16 PERSIST, §36). SIMULATION: a What-If recomputation with user overrides; nothing is recorded (spec §32; ADR-0026).

persisted.description: true when the result was stored as a recommendation run (COMPARISON); false for SIMULATION.

userOverrides.description: null for COMPARISON; the supplied overrides for SIMULATION (possibly an empty object).

TransportAssumptionsApplied.description: The transport assumptions behind every estimate in the response (spec §32; ADR-0023 item 5, ADR-0026 item 1). The configured values come from the version the comparison run used. The client-side What-If recalculates with these values and the spec §32 formula (departure D-13). The mandatory transport label shows this rate: 'Estimated — based on ₹{appliedRatePerKm}/km assumption. Actual costs will vary.' A fixed ₹8/km is never shown when the applied rate differs (ADR-0038; departure D-14).

versionId.description: Identifier of the configured transport-assumptions version (ADR-0026 item 1).

ratePerKm.description: Configured rate in rupees per km per trip of that version (spec §32 default ₹8.00).

minimumTripCharge.description: Configured minimum charge in rupees per trip (spec §32 default ₹300).

vehicleCapacityKg.description: Configured vehicle capacity in kilograms, used for the trip count (spec §32 default 1,000 kg).

appliedRatePerKm.description: Rate actually used for the estimates in this response: ratePerKm, or the user's transportRatePerKm override in a simulation.

ratePerKmSource.description: USER_OVERRIDE exactly when the simulation request supplied transportRatePerKm (even if it equals the configured rate); CONFIGURED otherwise, and then appliedRatePerKm equals ratePerKm.

SellingEstimates.description: ESTIMATED economics of selling the whole quantity at this market (spec §32, FR-07 to FR-09, §49). Computed with exact decimal arithmetic from the observed modal price, the rounded distanceKm and the applied transport assumptions: trips = ceil(quantityInKg / vehicleCapacityKg); estimatedTransportCost = round2(max(minimumTripCharge, distanceKm x appliedRatePerKm) x trips); estimatedGrossValue = round2(modalPrice x quantityInQuintal); estimatedNetRealization = estimatedGrossValue - estimatedTransportCost. round2 rounds half-up to 2 decimal places (ADR-0008). These are estimates, never guarantees (spec §49).

estimatedNetRealization.description: Gross value minus transport cost, in INR. Can be negative.

currency.description: All estimates are totals in Indian rupees (ADR-0022 item 10).

rank.description: Position 1..N under decisionBasis.rankingMethod. options[] is ordered by rank.

approximateMarketLocation.description: true when the market's coordinates are its district centroid (spec §16 is_approximate; ADR-0014), so the distance is coarser than usual. Every distance is approximate in any case (spec §47 Q6).

price.description: The single observation this option was computed from, chosen by ADR-0010 (current-dataset precedence; exact variety and grade filter, otherwise the lower-median representative). A real, unmodified government-reported price with full provenance.

trendDirection.description: Trend of this market and commodity (ADR-0025), on the variety- and grade-filtered daily series when a filter is set (ADR-0010 rules 3 and 7). Always INSUFFICIENT_DATA when price.reportDate is before today - 6, because the recent window is then empty.

reasonCodes.description: Reasons attached by the spec §16 rules, in the order of the ReasonCode enumeration. Possibly empty.

ExcludedMarket.description: A market inside the radius that was not ranked (ADR-0023 item 3). Excluded markets are never persisted.

MarketComparisonResponse.description: Ranked, explained comparison of the markets within the radius (spec §16 RESPOND, §30). With options it identifies the price-only winner and the net-realization winner; with no eligible option it is still a 200 response with an empty options array (spec §29; ADR-0023). Spec §16 names `commodityName`: it is `commodity.name` here, because reference names are returned as name, nameHi and nameMr (ADR-0022 item 11).

recommendationId.description: COMPARISON: identifier of the recorded run (spec §16). SIMULATION: the identifier of the run that was simulated; no new run is created.

variety.description: The variety filter applied, or null.

grade.description: The grade filter applied, or null.

priceUnit.description: Unit of every price in this response. Always 'Rs./Quintal': comparison accepts no other unit, and other units are rejected with 422 UNSUPPORTED_PRICE_UNIT (ADR-0008).

quantity.description: The quantity used, in quantityUnit: the request value, or, when a simulation supplied a quantity override, that override in KG.

quantityInQuintal.description: quantity converted to quintals (spec §32: KG / 100). Exact; at most 5 decimal places.

maxDistanceKm.description: The search radius used, in whole kilometres.

priceOnlyWinnerId.description: Market with the highest modal price among options; ties go to the higher estimated net realization, then the shorter distance, then the first market name in code-point order, then market id (ADR-0023 item 2). null when options is empty.

netRealizationWinnerId.description: The rank-1 option's market (spec §16 'rank 1 by composite score'; ADR-0023 item 2). In a SIMULATION, rank 1 by estimated net realization (ADR-0026 item 2). null when options is empty.

rankingsDisagree.description: true exactly when priceOnlyWinnerId and netRealizationWinnerId differ (spec §16, F1.13). Drives the WinnerCalloutBanner.

excludedMarkets.description: Markets in range that were not ranked (ADR-0023 item 3), ordered by distanceKm, then market name (code-point order), then market id (contract-design order).

noDataReason.description: NO_RECENT_PRICE_DATA exactly when options is empty (spec §29; ADR-0023); otherwise null.
